notes: H2 isotherms at 77 K up to 850 mmHg (Figure 7, main p. 4) for three samples: phenylene/silica hybrid (a), carbon/silica composite (b; about 36.5% carbon by TGA, so not majority carbon) and mesoporous carbon after HF removal of silica (c). Sample c is the carbon sorbent: 97% TGA weight loss in oxygen, surface area 850 m2/g (method not named; N2 sorption, BJH inset). Composite area 860 m2/g, hybrid 680 m2/g (main p. 2). Uptake values are from the ASAP 2010 sorption analyzer; the paper calls them 'calculated hydrogen-adsorption capacities' from the measured isotherms, not computed by theory. Communication with original data; no retraction or prior-publication statement found in main text or SI.
